subject.title: fix(agents): memoize exec auto-reviewer verdicts for identical requests (#102249)

question: Should OpenClaw cache model-backed exec auto-reviewer allow-once results, and must the cache key include the full reviewed input or prompt rather than only command, argv, cwd, and envKeys?
rationale: Exec auto-review sits on the process approval boundary, and the current PR changes when a later request bypasses a fresh model review while omitting reviewed policy metadata from the cache key.

options.title: Approve full-input per-run cache
options.body: Allow the optimization only when keyed by the full serialized reviewed input or prompt, scoped to one reviewer instance, and backed by proof.

options.title: Accept tuple-only reuse
options.body: Keep the narrower tuple key and intentionally allow changed host, reason, analysis, or agent metadata to reuse an earlier allow-once verdict.

options.title: Keep fresh review semantics
options.body: Reject caching for now and preserve one model review per approval miss until stronger security or cost evidence changes the decision.

recommendation.title: Approve full-input per-run cache
recommendation.body: Allow the optimization only when keyed by the full serialized reviewed input or prompt, scoped to one reviewer instance, and backed by proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame on the reviewer prompt and host call sites makes this the strongest routing candidate for the cache-boundary decision.
